“Okay. What are you doing with the curry powder, Senpai?”

“Understood. Oh—you look like a sushi chef, Shirou, cleaning fish so neatly with only one hand.”

“——Hm.”

For my own part, standing here in the kitchen with Sakura is a pleasure.

She is thoughtful enough to anticipate what I want and have everything ready before I ask.

Cooking with a partner like that is deeply satisfying.

Sakura is thoughtful and is attentive to my needs, preparing things ahead of time.
It feels really good to cook with someone like that.

I let out a quiet breath where Sakura will not notice and resume cleaning the sardines.

Their flesh is so soft that fingers work better than a knife. With my left hand still immobile, they are one of the few things I can just barely prepare.

“Oh. Is that all?”

……その遺体も、一人分以上四人分以下という有様だという話だった。

pages.en:
There is something horribly immediate about the report.

Early this morning, an older man out for his customary run discovered a trail of blood in the park and called the police.

The responding officers apparently found what they believed to be one person's blood, along with partial remains thought to belong to the victims.

…Those remains, however, were said to amount to somewhere between one and four people's worth.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It’s a pretty vivid incident.
An old man was jogging in the park, found a trace of blood, and reported it to the police.
A policeman came to the scene and found what appeared to be one person’s worth of blood and pieces of the apparent victims.
…But it seems the pieces are just scraps of flesh, and that they don’t even weigh fifty kilograms when gathered together.
…The remains are in a state where they can only narrow down the number of victims between one and four.

pages.ja: 「……警察では四人の身元を……って、なんで四人なんだ？ 一人分の血痕しかないのに」

“Does that mean they’re being indiscriminate?”

“…Hm. Why do you think it was an accident?”

“Because no one cleaned up afterward. The bloodstains are one thing, but Zouken isn't the kind to leave pieces of a body behind. In other words, Zouken wasn't at the scene. That incomprehensible shadow fed there on its own.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……Hm. Why do you think it’s an unforeseen accident?”
“It’s not cleaned up. With the blood aside, Zouken’s not someone that would leave pieces of the dead body behind. In other words, Zouken was not at the scene, and that shadow was the only thing that ate there.”

pages.en:
“It isn't a question of weight, but of shape. Maybe they found four of something a person should possess only one of. Then they wouldn't need forensic testing to know the number of victims.

“Think about it. If there were four different pairs of shoes in a sea of blood, anyone could tell how many people had been there.”

“It’s the shape, not the weight. I’m sure there was four of something people only have one of. That way, you’d know how many victims there are without any identification.
See. If there were four
left hands
different pairs of shoes
in a pool of blood, anyone would know how many victims there were.”
